description: For actual relation clauses and simultaneous substitutions into any residual alphabets, \((C\sigma)\tau=C(\tau\star\sigma)\), where \((\tau\star\sigma)(x)=\sigma(x)\tau\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.clause_subst_subst.{u, v, w, w', u_1} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type w} {β : Type w'} (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L α) (σ : α → L.Term β)
  {δ : Type u_1} (τ : β → L.Term δ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst τ
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst σ C) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose τ σ) C
